verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state PostHog is open-source and offers a free, MIT-licensed Docker Compose self-hosting option (posthog-docs-14, posthog-docs-21), which directly supports self-hosting the core product. However, a hands-on community report describes the production Docker deployment as broken (no database created), indicating real friction in practice. Missing for 10: recent/independent confirmation that the current self-host Docker setup works reliably, and documentation of feature parity between self-hosted and cloud versions.
